freightOwner.title: Milkiilaha Xamuulka
freightOwner.step1Desc: Ethiochinet Freight Owner App Store ama Google Play ka soo degso.
freightOwner.step3Desc: Heshiis dijitaal ah akhri saxiix gaarida oggolow.
freightOwner.step4Desc: Bilaabista gaarida oggolow xamuulkaagana si toos ah la soco.
freightOwner.step5Desc: Xamuulka qaado markii la dhammaystirona gaarsiinta xaqiiji.

driver.title: Darawal
driver.step1Desc: Ethiochinet Driver App Store ama Google Play ka soo degso.
driver.step2Desc: Jeebka dijitaalka buuxi si aad ugu qayb qaadato madasha.
driver.step3Desc: Amarrada xamuulka aqbal heshiis dijitaalna saxiix.
driver.step4Desc: Goobta qaadista tag xamuulka soo qaad gaarida bilow.
driver.step5Desc: Xamuulka gaarsi dhammaadka xaqiiji lacag-bixintana qaado.

vehicleOwner.title: Milkiilaha Baabuurka
vehicleOwner.step1Desc: Ethiochinet Vehicle Owner App Store ama Google Play ka soo degso.
vehicleOwner.step2Desc: Macluumaadka baabuurka oo lambarka lookhada ku jira galiso.
vehicleOwner.step3Desc: Darawal xirfadlaha ah u magac-abus baabuurka diiwaangeliyey.
vehicleOwner.step4Desc: Amarrada heshiisyada gaarsiimaha baabuur kasta la soco.
vehicleOwner.step5Desc: Dhammaan hawlaha baabuurka lambarka lookhada la soco si toos ah.

mission.title: Hadafkayaga
mission.description: Inaan warshadda logistics Itoobiya u beddelno marsad dijitaal ah oo xidha milkiilayaasha xamuulka iyo darawallada, gaarsiinta ku dhiga mid hufan, cad oo dhammaan heli karo.

vision.title: Aragtidayada
vision.description: Inaan noqono marsadda logistics dijitaalka ee ugu aaminsan Itoobiya, adeegsiga ganacsiyada iyo darawallada si loogu gaarsiiyo koboca dhaqaalaha qaran.

story.title: Sheekadayada
story.description: Ethiochinet waxay ka dhalatay indho la eegay: warshadda logistics Itoobiya waxay ahayd mid kala firirsan, wax-la-qabsi la'aanta, caddaansanaanta la'aanta. Sanadkii 2023, kooxda aasaasayaasha ah ayaa isu timid si ay xalkan u xalliyaan.
